plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends for the current fiscal year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Total Donors
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS donor_count FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Donation Mode Share
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT SUBSTR("Date", 1, 7) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: This year, the organization received a total of {{p1}} from {{p2}} unique donors. The highest contributions came from {{p3.0}}, which accounted for a significant portion of the total. UPI and Card payments were the most popular modes, as shown in the distribution chart. Monthly trends indicate steady growth throughout the year, with peaks in {{p5.0}} and {{p5.1}}.
